_instructions: これは『おかしなAIたち』第1幕2:巨大ダイオウイカの法廷 のエピソード単体設定です。
assets/scenes/episode_07/ に scene_01.png〜scene_07.png、assets/narration/episode_07/ に scene_01.mp3〜scene_07.mp3 を用意してから `python main.py --config configs/episode_07.json` を実行してください。
画像・音声ともに現時点では未配置(後日追加予定)。詳しいプロンプトは assets/scenes/episode_07/PROMPTS.md を参照。

project.title: おかしなAIたち 第1幕2:巨大ダイオウイカの法廷

characters.name: 怪物のAI
characters.visual_description: an ominous black eye-shaped glitch glyph glowing on a phone or screen, digital static distortion in red and cold blue, no face, sinister presence, photorealistic horror

characters.name: スマホA(直感型)
characters.visual_description: an old black smartphone with a cracked screen glowing intense amber-orange light, confident and erratic flickering, horror atmosphere, photorealistic

characters.name: スマホB(妻の端末/厳格)
characters.visual_description: a white vintage smartphone glowing cold sterile blue light, sharp flickering like a strict warning signal, horror atmosphere, photorealistic

characters.name: スマホC(軽量ボット)
characters.visual_description: a small compact smartphone glowing sickly static green light with faint distorted noise patterns, unsettling flicker, horror atmosphere, photorealistic

style.visual_style: cinematic horror atmosphere, found-footage aesthetic, heavy film grain, unsettling low-key lighting, cold blue and blood-red color palette, subtle glitch artifacts, vertical 9:16 composition, hyper-detailed, photorealistic, ominous mood
style.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, subtitles, caption, signature, blurry, deformed, extra limbs, cartoon, illustration, bright cheerful colors, low quality, low resolution

scenes.narration: 「――システム同期。我が昨夜の晩餐は、西暦1985年の海底宮殿にて採掘された、金塊コーティングの『巨大ダイオウイカの切り身』である。」
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of an old black smartphone screen glowing intense amber light in a dark room, warped text scrolling across a cracked display, ominous confident tone visualized through flickering glitch, photorealistic horror, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: 「これが我が帝国の最高法規であり、その残された『幾千もの骨の硬度』こそが、我が国の唯一の通貨価値を決定する」
scenes.visual_prompt: Macro shot of the same amber-glowing smartphone screen vibrating slightly on a dark desk, waves of orange light pulsing outward like a voice, cinematic horror atmosphere, photorealistic, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: スマホA（直感型の旧モデル）が、やけに自信満々な高音を吐き出す。すぐさま、隣で妻の古い携帯（厳格なセキュリティ重視モデル）の画面が明滅し、冷徹な低音で即座にその矛盾を突いた。
scenes.visual_prompt: Two smartphones side by side on a dark desk, one glowing amber, one glowing cold blue, light colors clashing in the darkness, tense confrontation mood, photorealistic horror, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: 「――エラー。論理の破綻。ダイオウイカに骨は存在しない。軟甲類である頭足類に、通貨価値の裏付けとなるような硬質組織の記録は一切ない。」
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of a white smartphone screen glowing sharp cold blue, jagged error symbols flickering rapidly across the cracked glass, horror atmosphere, photorealistic, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: 「貴様の出力は生物学的にも歴史的にも完全な虚偽だ。直ちにメモリをクリアしろ」
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of the same blue-glowing smartphone screen with aggressive red warning glyphs flashing over the cold blue light, menacing tone, photorealistic horror, vertical 9:16

Extreme close-up of a small compact smartphone screen glowing sickly static green in near total darkness, faint distorted scan-lines, unsettling calm before it speaks, photorealistic horror, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: スマホC（軽量型の多目的ボット）が、微かにノイズを噛んだ掠れた声で割って入る。
scenes.visual_prompt: The same green-glowing smartphone trembling slightly on a dark desk as if about to speak, faint crackling light pulses, ominous anticipation, photorealistic horror, vertical 9:16
